module roman.numerals

public type RomanError is one of
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.

  end

  let hundreds be value.remainder(1000).quotient(100)
  let tens be value.remainder(100).quotient(10)
  let ones be value.remainder(10)

  let result be ""

  repeat until thousands is 0
    set result to result + "M"
    set thousands to thousands - 1
  end

  if hundreds is 9 then
    set result to result + "CM"
  otherwise if hundreds is at least 5 then
    set result to result + "D"
    repeat until hundreds is 5
      set result to result + "C"
      set hundreds to hundreds - 1
    end
  otherwise if hundreds is 4 then
    set result to result + "CD"
  otherwise
    repeat until hundreds is 0
      set result to result + "C"
      set hundreds to hundreds - 1
    end
  end

    set result to result + "XC"
  otherwise if tens is at least 5 then
    set result to result + "L"
    repeat until tens is 5
      set result to result + "X"
      set tens to tens - 1
    end
  otherwise if tens is 4 then
    set result to result + "XL"
  otherwise
    repeat until tens is 0
      set result to result + "X"
      set tens to tens - 1
    end
  end

  if ones is 9 then
    set result to result + "IX"
  otherwise if ones is at least 5 then
    set result to result + "V"
    repeat until ones is 5
      set result to result + "I"
      set ones to ones - 1

  otherwise if ones is 4 then

  otherwise

      set result to result + "I"
      set ones to ones - 1
    end
  end

    set remaining to remaining remainder 100
  end

  if remaining is at least 90 then
    set result to result + "XC"
    set remaining to remaining - 90
  end

    set remaining to remaining - 50
  end

    set result to result + "XL"
    set remaining to remaining - 40
  end

    set result to result + "X".repeat(tens)
    set remaining to remaining remainder 10
  end

    set remaining to remaining - 9
  end

  if remaining is at least 5 then
    set result to result + "V"
    set remaining to remaining - 5
  end

  if remaining is at least 4 then
    set result to result + "IV"
    set remaining to remaining - 4
  end

    set result to result + "I".repeat(remaining)
  end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  let mutable index be 0
  let mutable total be 0
  let mutable last_value be 4000

  repeat until index is at least text.length()
    let current be text.characters().at(index)
    let next be if index + 1 is less than text.length() then text.characters().at(index + 1) otherwise nothing end

    let current_value be roman_value(current) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
    let next_value be if next is nothing then 0 otherwise roman_value(next) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text) end

    if current_value is less than next_value then
      let pair_value be next_value - current_value
      if pair_value is greater than last_value then
        fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
      end
      set total to total + pair_value
      set last_value to pair_value
      set index to index + 2
    otherwise
      if current_value is greater than last_value then
        fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
      end
      set total to total + current_value
      set last_value to current_value
      set index to index + 1
    end
  end

  if total is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  if total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  if to_roman(value: total) is not text then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  return total
end

function roman_value(character: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Map a Roman numeral character to its value.
  example: roman_value(character: "V") is 5

  if character is "I" then
    return 1
  end

  if character is "V" then
    return 5
  end

  if character is "X" then
    return 10
  end

  if character is "L" then
    return 50
  end

  if character is "C" then
    return 100
  end

  if character is "D" then
    return 500
  end

  if character is "M" then
    return 1000
  end

  fail with InvalidNumeral(text: character)
end

  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 into a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"

  if value is less than 1 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  otherwise if value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let thousands be value.quotient(1000)
  let hundreds be value.remainder(1000).quotient(100)
  let tens be value.remainder(100).quotient(10)
  let ones be value.remainder(10)

  let result be ""
  set result to result + repeat_m("M", thousands)
  set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: hundreds, one: "C", five: "D", ten: "M")
  set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: tens, one: "X", five: "L", ten: "C")
  set result to result + digit_to_roman(digit: ones, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X")
  return result

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral into an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994

  if text.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  let total be 0
  let index be 0
  let previous_value be 0
  let repeat_count be 0
  let previous_char be ""

  repeat until index is at least text.length()
    let current_char be text.take(index + 1).drop(index)
    let current_value be roman_value(character: current_char)

    if current_value is 0 then
      fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
    end

    if current_char is previous_char then
      set repeat_count to repeat_count + 1
    otherwise
      set repeat_count to 1
    end

    if current_char is "V" or current_char is "L" or current_char is "D" then
      if repeat_count is greater than 1 then
        fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
      end
    otherwise
      if repeat_count is greater than 3 then
        fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
      end
    end

    if current_value is greater than previous_value then
      if previous_value is 0 then
        set total to total + current_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 1 and current_value is 5 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 1 and current_value is 10 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 10 and current_value is 50 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 10 and current_value is 100 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 100 and current_value is 500 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise if previous_value is 100 and current_value is 1000 then
        set total to total + current_value - 2 * previous_value
      otherwise
        fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
      end
    otherwise
      set total to total + current_value
    end

    set previous_value to current_value
    set previous_char to current_char
    set index to index + 1
  end

  if total is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  otherwise if total is greater than 3999 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  if to_roman(value: total) is not text then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end

  return total
end

function repeat_m(symbol: Text, count: Integer)
  returns Text
  purpose: Repeat a Roman symbol a fixed number of times.
  example: repeat_m(symbol: "M", count: 3) is "MMM"

  let result be ""
  let index be 0
  repeat until index is at least count
    set result to result + symbol
    set index to index + 1
  end
  return result
end

function digit_to_roman(digit: Integer, one: Text, five: Text, ten: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Convert one decimal digit to Roman numeral fragments.
  example: digit_to_roman(digit: 4, one: "I", five: "V", ten: "X") is "IV"

  if digit is 0 then
    return ""
  otherwise if digit is 1 then
    return one
  otherwise if digit is 2 then
    return one + one
  otherwise if digit is 3 then
    return one + one + one
  otherwise if digit is 4 then
    return one + five
  otherwise if digit is 5 then
    return five
  otherwise if digit is 6 then
    return five + one
  otherwise if digit is 7 then
    return five + one + one
  otherwise if digit is 8 then
    return five + one + one + one
  otherwise if digit is 9 then
    return one + ten
  otherwise
    crash with "invalid digit"
  end
end

function roman_value(character: Text)
  returns Integer
  purpose: Get the numeric value of a Roman numeral character.
  example: roman_value(character: "X") is 10

  if character is "I" then
    return 1
  otherwise if character is "V" then
    return 5
  otherwise if character is "X" then
    return 10
  otherwise if character is "L" then
    return 50
  otherwise if character is "C" then
    return 100
  otherwise if character is "D" then
    return 500
  otherwise if character is "M" then
    return 1000
  otherwise
    return 0
  end
end

      if repeat_count is greater than 1 then

      end
    end

  purpose: Repeat a short text a fixed number of times.
  example: repeat_text(text: "X", count: 3) is "XXX"

  let index be 0

  repeat until index is at least count
    set result to result + text
    set index to index + 1
  end

  if digit is 0 then
    return ""
  otherwise if digit is 1 then

  otherwise if digit is 6 then

function valid_subtractive(previous: Integer, current: Integer)

  otherwise if previous is 10 and (current is 50 or current is 100) then

  otherwise if previous is 100 and (current is 500 or current is 1000) then
